messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novahealth.com>

Subject: Technical showcase with Solutions Engineering — NovaHealth (next steps)

Irene / Alex / Laura —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to set up a 45-minute technical showcase led by SE to walk through a tailored demo of Redwood Inference for NovaHealth engineering and security. High-level agenda attached (20270420-demo-agenda.pdf).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 27, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Apr 28, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Apr 29, 09:00–09:45

Can you confirm which of these works for the customer engineering and security teams? Karthik — can you join any of the above or recommend an SE backup if you're out?

Goals:
- Validate networking and data flow (security)
- Walk real inference latency/cost trade-offs on a sample workload
- Q&A + next steps (procurement/PO)

If none of these slots works, send 2 alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: 20270420-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novahealth.com>

Cc: Laura Procure <laura.procure@novahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Technical showcase with Solutions Engineering — NovaHealth (next steps)

Hi Marcus / Irene —

Thanks — appreciate the proposed times. Our engineering team has the following constraints this week: a sprint review on Tue morning and a vendor security review on Thu morning. From the customer side we'd be able to do:
- Wed Apr 28, 14:00–14:45 PT (preferred)
- Fri Apr 30, 11:00–11:45 PT (backup)

Note: our security team will need a short network requirements doc and a SOC 2 statement before the session. I copied our procurement lead Laura for PO cadence. Our security mailbox (security@novahealth.com) will route the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Alex Jenkins
Senior Platform Engineer | NovaHealth
alex.jenkins@novahealth.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novahealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Procure <laura.procure@novahealth.com>, security@novahealth.com
Date: 2027-04-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical showcase with Solutions Engineering — NovaHealth (next steps)

Alex — great, Wed Apr 28 14:00–14:45 PT works for us. Karthik (SE) — can you lock that slot into your calendar? If you're unavailable, Sofia Ivanova can run the deep-dive (she led the HelixHealth engagement last month and knows NovaHealth-style integrations well).

Karthik / Sofia — proposed focus for the 45-minute session:
- 5 min quick intro + objectives (AE + customer)
- 25 min SE demo: private deployment options, latency profiling, and quantization tradeoffs
- 10 min security & networking Q&A (customer security only)
- 5 min next steps (procurement + POC timeline)

Alex / security@novahealth.com — I've attached a short network checklist we usually send (see 20270421-network-requirements.txt). If you can confirm VPN/whitelisting needs and whether a direct peering discussion is required that would be helpful.

I'll create the Zoom invite and share a doc link for the demo notes. Marcus — can you own the procurement next-step note so Laura has visibility on PO timing?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachment: 20270421-network-requirements.txt

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Laura Procure <laura.procure@novahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical showcase with Solutions Engineering — NovaHealth (next steps)

Thanks Irene — Wed Apr 28 at 14:00 PT works in principle, but I have a partial conflict for an all-hands from 14:00–14:30 that day. I can join the last 30 minutes (14:15–14:45) but I'd prefer the full 45 to run the demo properly.

If you need full SE coverage for the full 45 I recommend Sofia lead (she has the same demo kit and access to our private deployment notes). I'll be on standby and jump in for the networking/Q&A portion. Sofia — can you confirm availability?

One quick ask for the demo: Alex, can you share one representative inference payload (anonymized) or a short prompt set so we can pre-run latency numbers? That will make the live demo far more relevant.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

All — locking Wed Apr 28 14:00–14:45 PT with Sofia as primary SE and Karthik joining for Q&A. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210. Agenda and notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X-demo-agenda

Alex / security: I've attached the network checklist again and a short demo env readme. For procurement, Laura — we'll plan to send a formal SOW and PO template after the session; happy to align timelines — Marcus will follow up with an estimated scope and costs.

Attachments: 20270420-demo-agenda.pdf, 20270421-network-requirements.txt

Quick timing note: Sofia — please prepare a 15-minute demo path focused on private deployment + inference latency and a 10-minute section on quantization and cost/throughput tradeoffs. Karthik, if you can join by 14:15 PT for the last 30 min that would be ideal.

Thanks everyone — see you Wed.
